_comment: Placeholder, non-secret values only. Real ConnectionStrings/Redis values belong in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or environment variables / Key Vault (prod) — never in this file. See .claude/rules/backend.md and CLAUDE.md rule 9.

EmailConfirmation._comment: Placeholder — the frontend has no /confirm-email route yet (P0-15 is backend-only). Must become the real production frontend origin before launch.

PasswordReset._comment: Placeholder — the frontend has no /reset-password route yet (P0-21 is backend-only). Must become the real production frontend origin before launch.

Security._comment: SE-03 (docs/SECURITY.md §2). Not a secret — safe to commit. Per-account overrides live on Users.MaxConcurrentSessionsOverride, not here.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey below is an obviously-fake, randomly-generated placeholder (CHANGE_ME_DEV_ONLY_ prefix, same convention as ConnectionStrings' CHANGE_ME) — never the real production key. The real key belongs in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env/Key Vault (prod), per security.md; never commit a real one here.

Seed._comment: P0-37 dev/test bootstrap accounts (`dotnet run --project backend/src/Siri.Api -- --seed`). AdminEmail is a non-secret placeholder, safe to commit. AdminPassword/TestUserPassword are the literal string CHANGE_ME on purpose — IdentitySeeder refuses to run while either still has that value. Set real ones via `dotnet user-secrets set "Identity:Seed:AdminPassword" "..."` / `...:TestUserPassword` (run from backend/src/Siri.Api) before seeding for real. See CLAUDE.md's seed/bootstrap section.
